import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long raise(long p, long pow) {
        long mod = 1000000007L;
        long ans = 1L;
        while (pow-- > 0) {
            ans = (ans * p) % mod;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long p = scanner.nextLong();
        long k = scanner.nextLong();
        long power = 1L;

        if (k == 0) {
            power = p - 1;
        } else if (k == 1) {
            power = p;
        } else {
            long x = k;
            while (x != 1) {
                x = (x * k) % p;
                power++;
            }
            power = (p - 1) / power;
        }

        System.out.println(raise(p, power));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
